verseText: Jesus declared, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’ This is the first and greatest commandment.
meaning: Out of all the commandments in the Bible, there is one that is most important of all: to love God with all that we are and all that we have, more than anything else in the world.

recall.question: What is the first and greatest commandment?
choices: Love the Lord with all your heart, soul, and mind

meaning.question: What does it mean to love God this way?
choices: Put Him first with our whole selves
Think about Him once a week

application.prompt: Choose one part of your day—your thoughts, choices, or energy—and offer it to God in love.
